decisions.reason: Adding a 100 kΩ pull-down to the MT3608 enable pin does not change the AXP2101 battery overcharge or overdischarge protection requirements.
The MT3608 enable pull-down does not change the J_BAT NTC connection or AXP2101 thermal-protection behavior.
The pull-down is on the boost converter enable pin and does not alter the I2C bus pull-ups, speed, or interboard cable constraint.
